errors.INVOICE_NOT_READY: The invoice for this order is not ready yet. It becomes available once it has been issued.
errors.INVOICE_NUMBER_PATTERN_COLLIDES: This numbering pattern can produce the same document number as another sales channel. Invoice numbers must be unique across the whole platform.
errors.INVOICE_NUMBER_PATTERN_COLLIDES.o: This numbering pattern can produce the same document number as sales channel "{channel}". Invoice numbers are unique across the whole platform, so give this channel a pattern the other one cannot repeat — adding the channel token is the usual way.
errors.INVOICE_NUMBER_PATTERN_COLLIDES.n: This numbering pattern has no sequence token, so every document in this channel would be given the same number. The field description lists the tokens you can use.
errors.INVOICE_NUMBER_ALREADY_ISSUED: This document number is already in use. Invoice numbers are unique across the whole platform.
errors.INVOICE_NUMBER_ALREADY_ISSUED.oth: Invoice number {number} is already used by sales channel "{channel}". Give this channel its own numbering pattern before issuing again — nothing was issued.
errors.INVOICE_NUMBER_ALREADY_ISSUED.sam: Invoice number {number} has already been issued in this sales channel, so its numbering pattern is producing repeats — nothing was issued.
